name: MOA (Companion)
masteryRankNote: No MR gate on Legs' shop or on MOA parts. Gate is the Vox Solaris quest plus Solaris United rank.

prerequisites.detail: Complete the Venus Junction from Earth to unlock Fortuna.
Wiki lists it as the prior main quest before Vox Solaris.
Start by talking to Eudico in Fortuna. Unlocks Legs' full MOA shop, The Business (fishing), Smokefinger (mining), Ticker (debt-bonds).
Legs sells the cheapest part of each category at Neutral, so building an ungilded MOA needs no rank grind.
Hard requirement to gild. Ungilded MOAs earn no mastery and cannot be polarized, renamed or given a Focus Lens.
Separate from the 2 + 2 + 2 Training Debt-Bonds spent on rank-ups to Doer.

routes.notes: Also the assembly and gilding NPC.

routes.notes: The only way to clear a MOA you no longer want. Parts are never recovered.

modularParts.note: Four categories, one part from each. 4 Models x 4 Cores x 8 Gyros x 5 Brackets = 640 combinations. Every part: 24 h build, 50,000 credits, rushable for 25 Platinum, untradable.

Model.determines: Head/turret appearance, the two Precept mods the MOA comes with, and all Mastery Rank affinity

Core.determines: Rear appearance plus percentage modifiers to base Health / Shields / Armor

Gyro.determines: Front appearance plus a second set of Health / Shields / Armor modifiers

Bracket.determines: Leg appearance and mod polarities. Every bracket carries four Penjaga polarities; the bracket adds at most one more.

assembly: Buy one blueprint from each of the four categories from Legs with standing.
Build each blueprint in the Foundry: 24 h, 50,000 credits each (200,000 credits for a set). All four can build in parallel.
Return to Legs, pick 'Configure a MOA Companion', choose one Model + Core + Gyro + Bracket, preview the stats.
Pay 4,000 credits to assemble instantly. No second build timer.

statMath.rule: Core and Gyro percentages apply to the 350 base. Total of the three stats always sums to 1190 whatever the combination.

howPartsCombine.ungildedLimits: Cannot be renamed, customized, polarized, given a Focus Lens, and earns no Mastery Rank affinity. Can take an Orokin Reactor.

effects: Level resets to 0; the 30 ranks must be re-earned for the mastery.
Unlocks custom name (24 characters, hyphens only for punctuation).
Unlocks Mastery Rank affinity gain, polarization, Focus Lens, customization.
One polarity must be chosen during gilding.

mastery.rule: Only the Model category grants mastery, and only once per unique Model. A second gilded MOA using an already-mastered Model gives nothing no matter what Core/Gyro/Bracket it uses. Four Models exist, so 24,000 is the ceiling.

trading.playerTrading: None. Parts and assembled MOAs are untradable.
trading.disassembly: Not possible. Components cannot be recovered from an assembled MOA.
trading.disposal: Donate to Legs for standing: 1,800 (rank 30 ungilded), 2,400 (gilded), 3,600 (gilded with an Orokin Reactor).

purchase.option: Legs' 'Today's Special' sells one fully assembled, gilded MOA for Platinum.
purchase.caveat: The Model/Core/Gyro/Bracket combination is randomized daily and cannot be chosen. Buying it still grants the Model's 6,000 mastery if that Model is new to you.
purchase.rushBuild: 25 Platinum rushes any single part's 24 h build.

community.painLevel: no RNG anywhere, but the highest up-front cost of any companion in the game; the real job is four MOAs, not one
community.headline: Each Model carries two precepts and each of the four has at least one worth owning, so the practical goal is one MOA per Model. That is 16 parts, four gildings and eight level-to-30 passes, not one build.
community.recommendedMode: Solo, normal. Gorgaricus sacs frequently fail to drop spores in multiplayer, and the standing farm is solo work anyway.
community.preferredRoute: Legs' standing route for the blueprints, with Conservation as the standing engine behind it. Today's Special is worth a look only when it rolls a Model you do not already own.

modelPriority.verdict: Build first. Blast Shield with Manifold Bond lets the MOA abuse shield gating and makes it arguably the tankiest companion in the game. Hard Engage is widely panned: it overrides the MOA's AI and overwrites weapon damage types against Manifold Bond.
Security Override auto-hacks consoles, the MOA's genuinely unique trick, strong in Spy and Archon Spy. Tractor Beam is a novelty.
Whiplash Mine is a good 20m grouping tool. Anti-Grav Grenade is niche.
Stasis Field gives 60% damage reduction against enemy gunfire over a wide area. Shockwave Actuators is dead weight.

community.partSelection: Core and Gyro only matter for clearing 343 base shields for Reinforced Bond, and Blast Shield pushes you past that anyway, which frees mod space. Bracket is the polarity pick: Tian's Vazarin saves a Forma. Model is fashion once you own all four. Any Sentinel weapon except Deconstructor; Verglas and Helstrum are the usual picks.
community.standingFarm: Conservation is the most-recommended method: Loki for invisibility with Rest & Rage subsumed to sleep animals, rare Kubrodons at roughly 8,000 standing in about 5 minutes. Mining works but is slower.

costForAllFourModels.source: derived from the wiki figures above, not from community numbers
costForAllFourModels.standingBreakdown: 71,000 rank-ups to Doer, plus 12,500 in blueprints (Models at 500 + 1,000 + 2,000 + 3,000, plus a 500-standing Core, Gyro and Bracket for each of the four MOAs), plus 5,000 gilding x4
costForAllFourModels.trainingDebtBondBreakdown: 6 across the rank-ups to Doer, plus 10 per gilding x4
costForAllFourModels.excludes: Smokefinger refining fees, Ticker debt-bond cases (5,000-350,000 credits each) and any part above the 500-standing tier

timeEstimate.community: 4+ days minimum, realistically about a week, for one MOA including resource gathering
timeEstimate.wikiDerived: 24 h of Foundry time per MOA with all four parts queued together; about 103,500 standing for all four Models is roughly 5 days at an MR10 cap of 21,000/day
timeEstimate.note: Gilding resets rank, so the full set is eight level-to-30 passes.

traps: Personality modules cost 50 platinum each and lower DPS: the MOA plays emotes mid-combat and dies more. Keep a second loadout without one.
MOAs cannot use Resourceful Retriever or the other loot mods, which is a hard dealbreaker for farming runs and the usual reason players stay on beast companions.
MOAs do not keep up with fast movement (Titania pixie mode, Wukong cloud), which cancels much of the auto-hack advantage since you wait at the console for them anyway.
Hard Engage overrides the MOA's AI, overwrites weapon damage types against Manifold Bond, and does not proc what its description implies. Skip it.
Nautilus groups better and Diriga primes better; the MOA's case is versatility, not being best-in-class.
tips: Nychus is a Doer-rank blueprint, so the standing grind to Doer is unavoidable if you want the Model that matters.

Community claim, not confirmed on the wiki pages read: a Model's precepts can be equipped on any MOA, two at a time, which is what makes building all four a one-time unlock rather than four permanent companions.
Consensus is to build MOAs when you have credits and standing to burn, not as a priority farm.

conflicts.wiki: All four parts build in parallel: 24 h wall clock per MOA, then instant assembly.
conflicts.community: Four separate builds each with their own timer, so 4+ days minimum and realistically about a week.
conflicts.why: The wiki is right about the Foundry. The community week is resource gathering and standing, which the app should show as the standing budget instead of as build time.

conflicts.wiki: 204,000 credits per MOA (4 x 50,000 Foundry plus 4,000 assembly), 816,000 for four, plus 85,000 in rank-up credits to Doer.
conflicts.community: Roughly 1.5 million credits total, including mineral refining and assembly.
conflicts.why: The wiki figure is verifiable. The extra several hundred thousand is unpublished Smokefinger refining and Ticker case cost, so show 901,000 for four gilded MOAs and note refining sits on top.

conflicts.wiki: Legs sells the cheapest part of each category at Rank 0 Neutral; Doer (Rank 3) is required only for gilding. Old Mate is Rank 5, not Rank 3.
conflicts.community: Fortuna rank 3 (Old Mate progression) minimum, because Legs will not sell you anything before that.
conflicts.why: An ungilded MOA needs no rank grind at all. Doer is still needed in practice for gilding and for the Nychus blueprint, which is why the community reads it as a hard gate.

effortWhy: The realistic job is one MOA per Model: about 103,500 standing, 900,000 credits, 16 parts of Orb Vallis mining and fishing, and eight level-to-30 passes, all with no RNG to shortcut.

effortReadings.why: About 78,000 standing to Doer plus the cheapest part set, 204,000 credits, and two level-to-30 passes.

effortReadings.goal: All four Models, gilded, for the precepts and the 24,000 mastery
effortReadings.why: Four times the parts, credits and levelling on top of the same one-time rank grind.

gotchas: Gilding needs Solaris United rank Doer, so the cheap rank-0 parts do not let you skip the standing grind if you want mastery.
Gilding resets the MOA to rank 0, so you level it to 30 twice: once to qualify, once to bank the mastery.
Only the Model grants mastery, 6,000 once per unique Model, so a second MOA on the same Model is worth zero mastery regardless of the other three parts.
An assembled MOA can never be taken apart or traded; a wrong combination is only recoverable by donating it to Legs for standing.
Rank-ups consume standing, so reaching Doer costs 71,000 earned standing, not 44,000.
Training Debt-Bonds are untradable and you need 16 in total across rank-ups and gilding, so start banking them from your first bounty runs.
Ticker's stock rotates on an 8-hour timer, so check between bounty sessions rather than waiting a day.
Orb Vallis weather cycles warm and cold, and several servofish only spawn in one of them (Tink, Sapcaddy and Tromyzon cold, Echowinder and Eye-Eye warm).
Gorgaricus sacs frequently fail to drop spores in multiplayer; the wiki recommends farming them solo.
The four blueprints all take 24 h, so queue all four in the same Foundry session or you turn one day into four.
